title: Microsoft Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac view-only conversion
summary: A Hacker News trending post discussing Microsoft's discontinuation of view-only access for Office 2019 and 2021 for Mac, with users discussing the impact on consumers and alternative solutions.
problem_solved: Addresses the forced conversion of purchased software to subscription model and loss of perpetual license functionality.
why_valuable: Highlights growing concerns about software ownership rights and subscription-model pressure tactics affecting millions of Mac users.
